decision_conditions: This consent is valid for two years.Reason: In order that the nature of work pertaining to this consent remains appropriate.

The pruning works hereby approved shall be strictly limited to a crown reduction of the re-growth around the periphery of the crown only. The most recent pruning points shall not be exceeded, and no pruning works shall take place elsewhere in the crown. All growth within the internal crown structure shall be left in situ, in order to provide the tree with leaf bearing structure wherewith it can continue its physiological processes after the works hereby approved. The works shall be carried out strictly in accordance with British Standard 3998 [2010] 'Tree Works'. Reason: In the interests of the health, safety and appearance of the preserved tree.

Tree work should not be carried out during periods that are likely to interfere with or disturb breeding birds or mammals.Reason: In order to comply with the requirements of the Wildlife and Countryside Act (1981) and Conservation of Habitats and Species Regulations (2010).
